| Legend |
| Icon | Name | Description |
| | **Level** | The minimum level which the player character must be in order to equip the weapon. This value cannot be modified once the weapon has been created. |
| | **Damage** | The damage caused per projectile. The damage is divided evenly between the number of projectiles. |
| | **Damage per second (DPS)** | The maximum cyclic damage dealt in one second, expressed as rate of fire times damage divided by 10. *(damage*firerate)/10* |
| | **Damage per AP (DAP)** | The damage dealt per action point, expressed as damage divided by AP cost. *damage/apcost* |
| | **Critical damage** | The amount of damage that is *added* when you score a critical strike. Critical strikes can only be triggered manually in V.A.T.S. *2.0 = +100% paper damage* |
| | **Area of effect (AOE)** | The distance radius of explosions. Some explosions have more than 1 radius, each with their own multiplier on damage dealt. |
| | **Fire rate** | The maximum cyclic number of shots/attacks per 10 seconds, without considering reloading. |
| | **Swing speed** | The rate at which a melee weapon can attack. |
| | **Range** | The distance at which the weapon ceases dealing full damage and applies an out-of-range damage multiplier, as well as the chance to hit in V.A.T.S. |
| | **Accuracy** | The cone-of-fire spread as well as the chance to hit in V.A.T.S. |
| | **AP cost** | The number of Action Points used per shot in V.A.T.S. |
| | **Ammunition used** | The type of ammunition the weapon uses. |
| | **Magazine capacity** | The ammunition capacity of the weapon. |
| | **Weight** | The weight value of the weapon. *Values listed here use the weapon's base weight, that is, before modifications are applied.* |
| | **Value** | Base value of the weapon in caps. Buy and sell values are effected by player Barter skill. |
| | **Value to weight** | The ratio of the base weapon value in caps to the weapon weight. *value/weight* |
| | **Gold bullion** | Weapon plan is unlocked with gold bullion. |
| | **Daily Ops** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Daily Ops. |
| | **Survival** | Weapon was only available for a limited time during Survival. |
| | **Nuclear Winter** | This weapon appears in the Nuclear winter battle royale. |
| | **Quests** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Quests. |
| | **Events** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Events. |
| | **Public events** | Weapon plan is rewarded from Public events. |
| | **Strength** | This is a Strength perk. |
| | **Perception** | This is a Perception perk. |
| | **Endurance** | This is an Endurance perk. |
| | **Charisma** | This is a Charisma perk. |
| | **Intelligence** | This is an Intelligence perk. |
| | **Agility** | This is an Agility perk. |
| | **Luck** | This is a Luck perk. |
| | **Legendary Perk** | This is a Legendary perk. |
| | **Physical** | Damage dealt by ballistic and explosive weapons. |
| | **Energy** | Damage dealt by lasers, electricity and plasma weapons. |
| | **Radiation** | Damage dealt through radioactive weapons. |
| | **Fire** | Damage from flame-based weapons and explosives, occasionally residual. |
| | **Cryo** | Damage dealt by cryogenic weaponry. Currently only in use by the war glaive cryo blade, Floater Freezers, and cryo arrows. |
| | **Poison** | Damage dealt by poisoned weapons, usually applied as damage-over-time *(dot)* . |
| | **Pure** | A damage type that currently cannot be resisted. Used exclusively by the wendigo colossus. |
| | **Explosive** | Area-of-effect damage from explosives. Damage type is borrowed from the weapon. |
| | **Bleed** | Damage-over-time from certain bladed melee weapons/mods. Uses physical damage, but is not resisted by DR. |
| | **Electrical** | Electrical damage is used only in the Electrically Charged mutation, and but is resisted by Energy Resistance. |
